profile.name: Pfeiffer TPG 300 真空规
profile.description: 用于测量实验真空系统压力的真空规。根据代码证据，该设备通过 Arduino 的 ADC 采集接口读取测量信号并返回真空测量值，适合用于真空状态监测。
profile.description_en: A vacuum gauge used to measure pressure in laboratory vacuum systems. Based on the driver evidence, its signal is read through an Arduino ADC interface and returned as measurement values for vacuum monitoring.
